name: Hoarder

notes: Replaces the names-only stub. Clean scan: the main objective is complete and you hold more cards in hand than any other player (strictly more). New hook rule.hand.mostCards.

name: Hope

text.goal: The colony pulls through and at least two helpless survivor tokens are on the board.

notes: Clean scan confirms the Portuguese fan sheet: at least two helpless survivor tokens on the board (the italic remark says helpless survivors turn up in search decks on most Outsider cards). Hook rule.board.helplessAtLeast.

name: Hunger

notes: Clean scan matches: at least three Food cards in hand.

name: Hypochondriac

text.goal: The colony pulls through and you hold at least two medicine cards.

notes: Corrected from the clean scan: at least two Medicine cards in hand, no other limit. The earlier record (hand of only Medicine, at least one) is the Neat Freak card.

name: Junkie

text.goal: The colony pulls through and you hold at least three medicine cards.

notes: Clean scan matches: at least three Medicine cards in hand. Starter-card wording is not printed, so none are excluded.

name: Justice

text.goal: The colony pulls through and, if the table has any traitors, every one of them has been exiled.

notes: Clean scan confirms the Portuguese fan sheet: if there is a betrayer, they have been exiled; with no traitor at the table the second clause holds on its own. Hook rule.traitors.allExiled.
